title: Mori as a mild, gentle older man, round 2
question: Which of these, if any, should become Mori's new base portrait?

media.caption: Suit, at the size the game shows portraits (desktop, every face the same height, chins level): Mio, Kenji, Hamada and Mori as they are now, then two suit renders I kept in round 1 (mo3-s3, mo3-s4), then the three kept suit renders of this round.
Cardigan, the same way: the current cast, two cardigan renders I kept in round 1 (mo4-s2, mo4-s4), then all four cardigan renders of this round.

Every render of this round in order, framed at the game's portrait scale, after the current portrait. The one change from round 1 is his build and bearing, after your "mori looks jacked, not the mild mannered grandpa type". Pass 1 came out chest-up, so pass 2 puts "standing" back in the pose words; pass 3 is the cardigan. Grey hair, the suit and cardigan options and the framing are as round 1. Seeds 1 to 4 in every pass.
Round 1 (mori-hamada-1) for comparison: the current portrait and all 16 Mori renders.

options.label: m1-s1
options.note: Mori, pass 1, suit: new build words (preset mori-mature v3: slender, slightly soft build, narrow sloping shoulders, slim neck), the muscle exclusion, and bearing words (gentle eyes, a mild warm smile, relaxed posture). Recipe art/candidates/portraits/mori-2/recipes/m1.json, seed 1, RDBT, portrait style, no-props. Red rim 0.9%. Framing: 12% missing above the game crop and 34% below (his waist is out of the render); the framed preview fills it flat, a pick gets a real outpaint. Dashboard #2409. My verdict, rejected: chest-up close-up, not waist-up; face mild and warm, neck slimmer than round 1, shoulders still wide.
